{{Top|leg}}
The '''hyperdrive inhibitor''',<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref> also known as the '''hyperdrive cut-off''',<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> '''hyperdrive cut-out''',<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> or '''hyperdrive safety shutdown''',<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]</ref> that was a safety feature on [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The inhibitor prevented starships from passing through a [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadow]],<ref name="RPG-Core" /> such as a [[Star/Legends|star]],<ref name="BGS" /> which could damage or destroy the vessel. If a mass shadow was detected, the inhibitor activated and dropped the ship out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] prematurely.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

When astrogation computers registered a sun, the hyperdrive inhibitor module prevented the ship from getting out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near the star, it did so by making the [[Navigation computer/Legends|nav computer]] program boot. It was possible, but dangerous, to disengage the inhibitor.

==History==
It was in use since the Old Republic, at least, and most starships carried hyperdrive inhibitors. Failure of the device would be fatal if the ship jumped to a location too close to a star.

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] registered as a huge [[Star/Legends|sun]] to the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] installed on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] due to the entity called [[Golden Sun]]. That way the planet remained hidden from galactic society for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], until an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout ship/Legends|Scout vessel]] found it by accident after its hyperdrive inhibitor burned out. In order to travel to Sedri, crews had to disable the hyperdrive inhibitor aboard their ships. Even so, ships sent to Sedri were still lost.<ref name="BGS" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tried to control the Golden Sun, that would have allowed them to hide Imperial fleets and planet as hyperdrive inhibitors would detect them as stars. However the Golden Sun vanished and regular travel to [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] became possible.
